name: Wolf Gold

features.name: Money respins
features.description: 6+ moon symbols trigger 3 respins where only moons land and the counter resets on each new moon.

features.name: Fixed jackpots
features.description: Mini, Major and Mega fixed jackpots are available through the respin feature.

features.name: Giant symbols
features.description: Stacked giant symbols can cover the middle reels in free spins.

review: Wolf Gold is a long-running medium volatility hold-and-win slot. It is less spectacular than modern tumble games but far gentler on a bankroll: wins arrive more often and the moon respin feature triggers frequently. A good choice if you want classic five-reel gameplay with a jackpot element.
author: editorial-team
